cards.title: Albert Einstein
cards.extract: Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist who is widely held to be one of the greatest scientists of all time.

cards.title: The Beatles
cards.extract: The Beatles were an English rock band formed in Liverpool in 1960.

cards.title: Photosynthesis
cards.extract: Photosynthesis is a system of biological processes by which photosynthetic organisms convert light energy into chemical energy.

cards.title: Roman Empire
cards.extract: The Roman Empire ruled the Mediterranean and much of Europe, Western Asia and North Africa.

cards.title: Black hole
cards.extract: A black hole is a region of spacetime where gravity is so strong that nothing can escape it.

cards.title: Domestic canary
cards.extract: The domestic canary is a small songbird in the finch family, originating from the wild canary of the Macaronesian islands.

cards.title: Saxophone
cards.extract: The saxophone is a type of single-reed woodwind instrument with a conical body, usually made of brass.

cards.title: Trebuchet
cards.extract: A trebuchet is a type of catapult that uses a long arm to throw a projectile.

cards.title: Karman line
cards.extract: The Karman line is a proposed conventional boundary between Earth's atmosphere and outer space.

cards.title: Sourdough
cards.extract: Sourdough is a type of bread made from the fermentation of dough using wild lactobacilli and yeast.

cards.title: Antikythera mechanism
cards.extract: The Antikythera mechanism is an ancient Greek hand-powered orrery, described as the oldest known analogue computer.

cards.title: Emu War
cards.extract: The Emu War was a nuisance-wildlife management operation in Australia in 1932 against emus.

cards.title: Lambert's cosine law
cards.extract: Lambert's cosine law describes how the observed radiant intensity from an ideal diffuse surface varies with viewing angle.

cards.title: Bunad
cards.extract: Bunad is an umbrella term encompassing traditional Norwegian rural clothing as well as modern folk costumes.

cards.title: Nanortalik
cards.extract: Nanortalik is a town in the Kujalleq municipality in southern Greenland.

cards.title: Dvorak keyboard layout
cards.extract: The Dvorak keyboard layout is an alternative to the QWERTY layout, designed to increase typing efficiency.

cards.title: Aquaplaning
cards.extract: Aquaplaning is the loss of traction that occurs when a layer of water builds between a wheel and the road surface.

cards.title: Kessler syndrome
cards.extract: The Kessler syndrome is a scenario in which the density of objects in low Earth orbit is high enough that collisions cascade.
